name: is-it-done-yet
description: A docked progress pane for long, multi-phase agent work. Looks through the markdown files of the project for a plan, checklist or progress note (judged by content, not file name) or uses the session's task list, and shows percent done, phases and tasks with bars, elapsed time, a rough ETA, tokens used and the API-equivalent cost. Adds nothing to the model's context.

autoOpen.title: Open on the first task
autoOpen.description: Open the pane by itself the first time the agent creates a task (only when the terminal is wide enough; /progress always works)
